source.title: Hold your horses: a dynamic computational role for the subthalamic nucleus in decision making

confidence_rationale: This is the canonical computational model of the exact mechanism MECH-439's proposed fix translates: the subthalamic nucleus (STN), driven by cortical response conflict, dynamically raises the response threshold via the cortico-subthalamic-pallidal (hyperdirect) pathway, and this matters MOST when there are multiple competing responses. That is the qualitative content of the conflict-graded hold k=f(F-gap) -- small top-score gap (near-tie / high conflict) widens the consideration window so a non-dominant stream can still win. Confidence is held below 0.8 by one load-bearing structural divergence: Frank's STN raises a CONTINUOUS, TEMPORAL threshold (it buys time within a within-trial evidence accumulator), whereas REE's lever widens a DISCRETE consideration set (top-k) at a single commit step with no within-trial temporal accumulation. The biology's hold helps only because more evidence accrues during the delay and can overturn the leading option; REE's set-widening helps only if a modulatory channel can outweigh F WITHIN the shortlist scoring. Where F still dominates the shortlist (the 654g/625e failures), widening k does not move the argmax -- precisely the gap the divergence predicts.
failure_signatures: Frank's STN hold buys TIME on a within-trial accumulator so that additional evidence can overturn the leading option; REE's E3 commit step has no within-trial temporal accumulation, so substituting top-k set-width for a temporal hold only helps if a non-F channel already outscores F within the shortlist -- where F monopolises the shortlist scoring (654g seed-44 byte-identical, 625e monostrategy) the analog of the hold is inert.

The model's benefit is contingent on there being multiple genuinely-competing cortical responses at near-equal strength; if one score (F) dominates the cortical input itself, the cortico-STN conflict signal is small and the threshold is never raised -- the diversity ceiling re-appears one level upstream, in the conflict signal, not just at the argmax.

mapping.source_claim_statement: The STN, omitted from earlier basal-ganglia action-selection models, modulates WHEN a response is executed: increased cortical response conflict drives dynamic upward adjustments of the response threshold via cortico-subthalamic-pallidal pathways, reducing premature responding. This has substantial effects on WHICH response is ultimately selected, particularly when there are multiple competing responses.
mapping.ree_translation: MECH-439 holds that the primary harm/goal score F monopolises ~88-89% of E3 committed-selection variance, so modulatory channels cannot move the committed argmax except at near-ties. The proposed fix (V3-EXQ-689a: _gap_scaled_commit_pick + conflict-graded top-k, k=f(top-F gap)) is the REE analog of Frank's cortico-STN hold: when the top-F gap is small (the near-tie / high-conflict regime), widen the committed-selection consideration set (raise the effective threshold for snapping to the F-argmax) so a non-dominant stream can convert to committed action. Frank 2006 is the foundational computational statement that a conflict-graded threshold-raising hold over BG action selection is a real, simulated mechanism -- not an ad hoc engineering patch.
mapping.mapping_caveat: LOAD-BEARING DIVERGENCE (not a caveat to wave away). Frank's mechanism raises a CONTINUOUS TEMPORAL threshold on a within-trial accumulator -- it delays commitment in time so MORE EVIDENCE can accumulate and overturn the early leader. REE's k=f(F-gap) widens a DISCRETE set (top-k) at a single commit step and has no within-trial temporal accumulation: it substitutes set-width for time. The two are only equivalent if widening the set is accompanied by a competing signal that can outscore F within the shortlist. The biology predicts the hold is USELESS without an independent accumulation process capable of reversing the leader given time; REE's analog is correspondingly useless where F also dominates the within-shortlist scoring. This is exactly the residual-ceiling (Reading-2) risk the cluster autopsy flags, and it means a 689a PASS confirms the hold-analog only if the lift correlates with the per-tick F-gap (the pre-registered falsifier).
mapping.source_context: Neural-network computational model of cortico-basal-ganglia circuitry (direct/indirect/hyperdirect pathways) during response selection; validated against Parkinson's-disease and pharmacological-challenge data on premature responding and decision conflict; single-author foundational paper, heavily replicated downstream.

confidence_components.notes: Source quality high: canonical, foundational, heavily cited, and its novel predictions were subsequently confirmed empirically (Cavanagh 2011, Frank 2015). Mapping fidelity high on the QUALITATIVE mechanism (conflict-graded threshold raising during multi-option competition) but discounted for the temporal-threshold-vs-discrete-set-width structural gap. Transfer risk moderate: model-to-model transfer is reasonable, but REE lacks the within-trial temporal accumulator that carries the biology's benefit, so the analog can be inert in exactly the F-dominated regime MECH-439 targets.
